acceptance: With the remote unreachable and a cached revision present, `todo-db-mcp` starts, and read tools serve the cached revision marked stale, as ADR 0007 and the README describe.
With the remote unreachable, mutations return `E_OFFLINE` with a retry step instead of the server failing to start.
A reachable remote without the state branch still stops startup with the `todo-db bootstrap` hint.
The behaviour with the remote unreachable and no cache is decided and documented: fail at startup, or start and answer every call with `E_OFFLINE`.
description:
ADR 0007 and the README say offline reads may serve a cached revision marked stale. The MCP server never gets that far: `main()` in `src/todo_db/mcp/server.py` runs `startup_check`, which calls `ls_remote_tip` and exits with status 2 ("error: state remote unreachable: ...") when the remote does not answer. The client sees only "Connection closed", so an agent loses every tracker read during an outage or on a slow network, including reads the cache could serve.

Reproduced on 0.11.0 (2026-10-31): bootstrap a bare remote, create an item through the server so the cache holds that revision, move the remote away, and start the server again. It exits within a second with that error, and the cached item cannot be read. The same failure happened against GitHub on 2026-10-28, when `ls-remote` timed out (`Recv failure: Operation timed out`) and the client closed after about 48 seconds.
